title: World Creation, Housing, Relationships, and Family Foundation
changes: Added a typed world-creation authority covering world size, landform, land coverage, coastline, mountains, marine water, rivers, lakes, ponds, wetlands, waterfalls, biomes, forests, settlements, housing, relationships, and family rules.
Added a seven-page in-game world-creation wizard reached from the existing Create World card.
New worlds now persist their complete generation request and finite wrapped topology alongside the existing compatibility archipelago bootstrap.
Added city and village housing targets: cities expose multiple rental/purchase opportunities while villages normally expose one and may occasionally expose a second.
Added persistent world social-state contracts for properties, tenure, households, reputation, NPC/player relationships, player-player and player-NPC marriage, children, adoption, and pregnancy state.
Added an ElizaWy pregnancy-body asset role and strict audit/clothing-compatibility policy without inventing an unverified source filename.
Preserved Willowmere as mandatory, continuous outdoor-world direction, and the no-static-player-farmstead rule.
